create_tokenizer_blenderbot_small: create a BlenderbotSmallTokenizer instance from vocab and merges files for BPE tokenization
build_bpe_token: build a BPE-encoded token string from raw input using the BlenderbotSmallTokenizer bpe method
test_tokenize_text: test the BlenderbotSmallTokenizer _tokenize method to split text into BPE subword tokens
convert_tokens_to_string: convert a list of BPE tokens back to a readable string using convert_tokens_to_string
save_tokenizer_vocab: save the BlenderbotSmallTokenizer vocabulary and merges files to a directory
